message.content: The issue is that finding #2 (group size imbalance) was not explicitly resolved. Although finding #3 (confounding due to segment and age) was acted upon, the imbalance in group sizes was not directly addressed in the resolution. I must now resolve finding #2 by explicitly stating that the imbalance led to the need for adjustment, which was done via stratification.

function.arguments: {"index": 2, "status": "acted", "resolution": "The imbalance in group sizes (359 email vs. 541 paid search) was identified as a potential source of confounding. This imbalance, combined with observed differences in customer segment and age, violated the premise of group comparability. To address this, I used stratification (standardization) by customer segment and age group to compute an adjusted difference in conversion rates, which accounts for both the size imbalance and confounding variables. This method ensures a valid comparison."}
function.name: resolve_finding
